questions.question: A prophet said a day of tumult, trampling and confusion was set for the Valley of Vision. Who set that day?
Jerusalem built a reservoir between its walls to prepare for attack. What does the prophet say the people did not do?

answers.text: Look to the One who made it
Gather enough workers for the job
Collect enough stone for the wall

questions.question: When God called for weeping and sackcloth in Jerusalem, the people instead feasted and celebrated. True or false?
The LORD of Hosts spoke about the sin of Jerusalem's people, who feasted instead of mourning. What did He say about it?

answers.text: It will never be atoned for
It will be forgiven before long
It will be paid for by sacrifice
